brief: Bright open-plan office on a high floor with full-height glazing and thin dark mullions looking over a blue-glass city skyline. A long white trestle-leg desk with black moulded chairs sits in the foreground, and a second desk with a monitor sits further back near the window. A tufted emerald-green velvet sofa and a small round coffee table form a lounge corner on the right. Tall potted ficus and bamboo plants soften the glass and white walls. A double-height atrium with white mezzanine balustrades, a timber slat ceiling and a dark bookshelf wall lies behind. Mood: airy, sunlit, corporate-modern. Desk surfaces hold a closed laptop, tablet, takeaway coffee cup, mesh pen pot, small succulent, calculator, papers and a blue lanyard with ID badge. Warm wood floor with sun stripes, and a patterned rug in the lounge.
